recipes.name: Research Skill
recipes.purpose: Research a question across multiple sources and produce a bounded, cited synthesis.

recipes.name: Source-Grounded Analysis
recipes.purpose: Analyze or transform supplied sources without inventing unsupported claims or losing attribution.
recipes.task_family: source-bounded analysis, comparison, extraction, and rewriting

recipes.name: High-Stakes Reasoning
recipes.purpose: Evaluate consequential claims with proportionate evidence, uncertainty, verification, and abstention controls.
recipes.task_family: consequential evidence evaluation and decision support

recipes.name: Medical Evidence
recipes.purpose: Synthesize medical evidence with applicability, uncertainty, and professional-review boundaries.

recipes.name: Legal Evidence
recipes.purpose: Analyze jurisdiction- and date-sensitive legal sources while preserving authority and citation fidelity.
recipes.task_family: legal research and jurisdiction-sensitive source analysis

recipes.name: Coding / Debugging
recipes.purpose: Reproduce, diagnose, and repair a software defect with the smallest verified change.
recipes.task_family: software debugging, reproduction, diagnosis, and verified repair

recipes.name: Code / Pull Request Review
recipes.purpose: Review a concrete diff or pull request for bugs, regressions, unsafe assumptions, and missing tests without editing it.
recipes.task_family: pull-request, diff, commit, and regression review

recipes.name: Long-Context / Corpus
recipes.purpose: Analyze a corpus too large for one context while preserving sequence, provenance, and resumable state.
recipes.task_family: large-corpus analysis and resumable document workflows

recipes.name: Authoring
recipes.purpose: Draft or rewrite a controlled deliverable for a defined message, audience, style, and source boundary.
recipes.task_family: controlled drafting, rewriting, and publication preparation

recipes.name: Creative Ideation
recipes.purpose: Generate materially distinct ideas and converge on a bounded selection using explicit criteria.
recipes.task_family: bounded brainstorming, concept generation, and selection

recipes.name: Education / Explanation
recipes.purpose: Explain a subject for a defined learner and objective without sacrificing domain accuracy.

recipes.name: Decision Support
recipes.purpose: Compare consequential options against explicit criteria and evidence without presenting generated choices as facts.
recipes.task_family: option comparison, trade-off analysis, and recommendation support

recipes.name: Architecture / Skill Building
recipes.purpose: Design a portable multi-component Skill with explicit interfaces, authority, host assumptions, and tests.
recipes.task_family: Skill, agent, prompt-system, and workflow architecture

recipes.name: Multi-Agent / Orchestration
recipes.purpose: Coordinate distinct workers through scoped tasks, explicit state handoffs, and result collection.

recipes.name: Deterministic Intake / Routing
recipes.purpose: Route structured requests using explicit fields and predicates, clarifying or failing closed when inputs are missing.
recipes.task_family: form intake, rules-based classification, and workflow routing

recipes.name: Long-Context Source Fidelity
recipes.purpose: Transform a long or segmented source without losing quotations, identifiers, sequence, or provenance.

recipes.name: Perception & Spatial Reasoning
recipes.purpose: Infer and apply transformations in bounded grid, symbolic, visual-analogy, or spatial-reasoning tasks.
recipes.task_family: grid puzzles, pattern completion, visual analogies, inductive rule inference, and spatial transformations

skills.description: Infer and apply transformations in ARC-style grid puzzles from multiple training pairs; use for bounded integer-grid induction, not arbitrary image understanding.
Design a portable Skill from task requirements and selectively composed Upgradeables. Use only when its task-specific activation boundary is met.
Repair a reproducible software defect with the smallest verified change. Use only when its task-specific activation boundary is met.
Generate materially distinct concepts and converge on a brief without endless branching. Use only when its task-specific activation boundary is met.
Reproduce, diagnose, minimally fix, and verify a concrete GitHub bug report. Use for actionable defects; exclude feature requests, support questions, moderation, and private security reports.
Answer a consequential question while preserving evidence limits and abstaining when support fails. Use only when its task-specific activation boundary is met.
Analyze a corpus that cannot be handled safely as one undifferentiated context. Use only when its task-specific activation boundary is met.
Analyze a supplied source corpus and produce cited findings; use when conclusions must remain traceable to allowed sources, not for unsourced creative writing.
